content_addressed_corpus_policy: This binding does not mutate data/frontier-candidates.public.jsonl or frontier-state.v1.json. Those artifacts change only through a full deterministic refresh that recomputes all source pins, candidate rows, and digests.

candidates.role: candidate retrieval backend for admitted text and document-page-image evidence
candidates.model_identity_policy: Pin the exact upstream Hugging Face revision at benchmark time and carry it into every index and query receipt.
required_invariants: run current SZL retriever on identical checksum-pinned qrels as the control
page screenshots and text documents remain distinguishable in provenance
dense and late-interaction indexes are disposable derived state
retrieved evidence never gains execution authority
unsupported or failed multimodal inputs use an explicit measured fallback

candidates.role: architecture pattern for durable local traces plus derived hybrid recall
candidates.adoption_policy: Adopt the raw-trace-plus-derived-index pattern and interoperability ideas; do not relabel Funes as SZL-originated software or make an unreviewed external memory store authoritative.
required_invariants: raw traces are the system-of-record evidence and embeddings/indexes are disposable derived state
redaction and secret scanning occur before every synchronization boundary
tenant, domain, purpose, lifecycle state, and source provenance accompany every recalled memory
tombstones and deletions propagate to all derived indexes before recall resumes
memory is context evidence only and cannot authorize tools, writes, training, or production actions
